WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(NUMERIC(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES)),0) BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTBUSINESSASSETS)),0) CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS)),0) CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTINVESTMENTS)),0) CUSTINVESTMENTS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTNETWORTH)),0) CUSTNETWORTH_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTPROPERTYASSETS)),0) CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),INCOME_FROM)),0) INCOME_FROM_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),INCOME_TO)),0) INCOME_TO_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES)),0) LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME)),0) NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),NET_SAVINGS)),0) NET_SAVINGS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),OTHERLIMITS)),0) OTHERLIMITS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE)),0) OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),VACANCYFACTOR)),0) VACANCYFACTOR_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),OVERTIMEINCOME)),0) OVERTIMEINCOME_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT1)),0) AMOUNT1_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT2)),0) AMOUNT2_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT3)),0) AMOUNT3_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT4)),0) AMOUNT4_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT5)),0) AMOUNT5_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT6)),0) AMOUNT6_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AMOUNT7)),0) AMOUNT7_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP)),0) ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP)),0) ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP)),0) ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL)),0) ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP)),0) ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP)),0) ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME)),0) ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME)),0) ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME)),0) ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP)),0) ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME)),0) ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_src
, CUSTBUSINESSASSETS CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_src
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src
, CUSTINVESTMENTS CUSTINVESTMENTS_src
, CUSTNETWORTH CUSTNETWORTH_src
, CUSTPROPERTYASSETS CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_src
, INCOME_FROM INCOME_FROM_src
, INCOME_TO INCOME_TO_src
, LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_src
, NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_src
, NET_SAVINGS NET_SAVINGS_src
, OTHERLIMITS OTHERLIMITS_src
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
, VACANCYFACTOR VACANCYFACTOR_src
, OVERTIMEINCOME OVERTIMEINCOME_src
, AMOUNT1 AMOUNT1_src
, AMOUNT2 AMOUNT2_src
, AMOUNT3 AMOUNT3_src
, AMOUNT4 AMOUNT4_src
, AMOUNT5 AMOUNT5_src
, AMOUNT6 AMOUNT6_src
, AMOUNT7 AMOUNT7_src
, ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_src
, ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_src
, ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_src
, ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_src
, ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_src
, ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_src
, ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_src
, ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_src
, ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_src
, ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_src
, ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_src


, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_tgt
, CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_tgt
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt
, CUSTINVESTMENTS_tgt
, CUSTNETWORTH_tgt
, CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_tgt
, INCOME_FROM_tgt
, INCOME_TO_tgt
, LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_tgt
, NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_tgt
, NET_SAVINGS_tgt
, OTHERLIMITS_tgt
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
, VACANCYFACTOR_tgt
, OVERTIMEINCOME_tgt
,AMOUNT1_tgt
,AMOUNT2_tgt
,AMOUNT3_tgt
,AMOUNT4_tgt
,AMOUNT5_tgt
,AMOUNT6_tgt
,AMOUNT7_tgt
,ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_tgt
,ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_tgt
,ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_tgt
,ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_tgt
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_tgt
, BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_src
, CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_src
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src
, CUSTINVESTMENTS_src
, CUSTNETWORTH_src
, CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_src
, INCOME_FROM_src
, INCOME_TO_src
, LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_src
, NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_src
, NET_SAVINGS_src
, OTHERLIMITS_src
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
, VACANCYFACTOR_src
, OVERTIMEINCOME_src
,AMOUNT1_src
,AMOUNT2_src
,AMOUNT3_src
,AMOUNT4_src
,AMOUNT5_src
,AMOUNT6_src
,AMOUNT7_src
,ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_src
,ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_src
,ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_src
,ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_src
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS COUNT_TGT
,CAST(BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_tgt
,CAST(CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_tgt
,CAST(CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt
,CAST(CUSTINVESTMENTS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTINVESTMENTS_tgt
,CAST(CUSTNETWORTH_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTNETWORTH_tgt
,CAST(CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_tgt
,CAST(INCOME_FROM_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS INCOME_FROM_tgt
,CAST(INCOME_TO_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS INCOME_TO_tgt
,CAST(LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_tgt
,CAST(NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_tgt
,CAST(NET_SAVINGS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS NET_SAVINGS_tgt
,CAST(OTHERLIMITS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS OTHERLIMITS_tgt
,CAST(OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
,CAST(VACANCYFACTOR_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS VACANCYFACTOR_tgt
,CAST(OVERTIMEINCOME_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS OVERTIMEINCOME_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT1_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT1_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT2_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT2_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT3_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT3_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT4_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT4_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT5_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT5_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT6_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT6_tgt
,CAST(AMOUNT7_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT7_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_tgt
,CAST(ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_tgt
,CAST(BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_src
,CAST(CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_src
,CAST(CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src
,CAST(CUSTINVESTMENTS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTINVESTMENTS_src
,CAST(CUSTNETWORTH_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTNETWORTH_src
,CAST(CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_src
,CAST(INCOME_FROM_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS INCOME_FROM_src
,CAST(INCOME_TO_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS INCOME_TO_src
,CAST(LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_src
,CAST(NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_src
,CAST(NET_SAVINGS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS NET_SAVINGS_src
,CAST(OTHERLIMITS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS OTHERLIMITS_src
,CAST(OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
,CAST(VACANCYFACTOR_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS VACANCYFACTOR_src
,CAST(OVERTIMEINCOME_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS OVERTIMEINCOME_src
,CAST(AMOUNT1_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT1_src
,CAST(AMOUNT2_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT2_src
,CAST(AMOUNT3_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT3_src
,CAST(AMOUNT4_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT4_src
,CAST(AMOUNT5_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT5_src
,CAST(AMOUNT6_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT6_src
,CAST(AMOUNT7_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS AMOUNT7_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_src
,CAST(ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,DATE
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_src
, CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_src
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src
, CUSTINVESTMENTS_src
, CUSTNETWORTH_src
, CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_src
, INCOME_FROM_src
, INCOME_TO_src
, LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_src
, NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_src
, NET_SAVINGS_src
, OTHERLIMITS_src
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_src
, VACANCYFACTOR_src
, OVERTIMEINCOME_src
,AMOUNT1_src
,AMOUNT2_src
,AMOUNT3_src
,AMOUNT4_src
,AMOUNT5_src
,AMOUNT6_src
,AMOUNT7_src
,ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_src
,ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_src
,ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_src
,ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_src
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_src
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES_tgt
, CUSTBUSINESSASSETS_tgt
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt
, CUSTINVESTMENTS_tgt
, CUSTNETWORTH_tgt
, CUSTPROPERTYASSETS_tgt
, INCOME_FROM_tgt
, INCOME_TO_tgt
, LOANREPAYMENTEXPENSES_tgt
, NET_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_tgt
, NET_SAVINGS_tgt
, OTHERLIMITS_tgt
, OUTSTANDING_MORTAGE_tgt
, VACANCYFACTOR_tgt
, OVERTIMEINCOME_tgt
,AMOUNT1_tgt
,AMOUNT2_tgt
,AMOUNT3_tgt
,AMOUNT4_tgt
,AMOUNT5_tgt
,AMOUNT6_tgt
,AMOUNT7_tgt
,ANNUAL_COMMIT_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_EXTPROD_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_INTPROD_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_LOAN_INSTAL_tgt
,ANNUAL_OPERATING_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_OTHER_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME_tgt
,ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME_tgt
,ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME_tgt
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_EXP_tgt
,ANNUAL_TOTAL_INCOME_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
